categories.main_business_segments: T3EX Global Holdings Corp. operates primarily in integrated international logistics services including sea freight, air freight, rail freight, customs brokerage, warehousing, inland transportation, supply chain management, cross-border e-commerce logistics, and supply chain finance. The company offers comprehensive logistics solutions covering import/export freight forwarding, customs clearance, warehousing, and distribution services, with a focus on multi-modal transport integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced information technology systems including proprietary IT software development for seamless integration of sea, air, rail freight, customs, and warehousing operations. Key technologies include electronic data interchange (EDI) for real-time data exchange with customers, cargo tracking systems, warehouse management systems (WMS), and transport management systems (TMS) with GPS tracking. The firm emphasizes customized IT solutions to meet client-specific logistics and supply chain needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: T3EX serves a diverse customer base including importers and exporters, manufacturers, distributors, and e-commerce businesses. Its major markets are in Greater China, Taiwan, Northeast Asia, Southeast Asia, and global long-haul routes to Europe, North America, and other regions. The company targets industries requiring integrated logistics and supply chain finance, including semiconductor, electronics, chemical, agricultural, and consumer goods sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with key presence in Taiwan, China (including Shanghai, Hong Kong, Suzhou, Guangdong, Qingdao), Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Cambodia, Philippines, Indonesia), Northeast Asia, and strategic offices in the USA, Japan, and Europe. It maintains a dual headquarters model with operational centers in Taipei (for non-China regions) and Shanghai (for China operations), and plans to expand regional hubs such as Singapore for Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: T3EX operates primarily as a midstream logistics service provider, acting as a freight forwarder and supply chain integrator. It coordinates upstream transportation providers (shipping lines, airlines, rail operators) and downstream services (warehousing, customs clearance, inland distribution) to deliver end-to-end logistics solutions. The company also extends into supply chain finance, supporting upstream and downstream partners financially.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation and IT system enhancement to improve logistics efficiency and customer service. Strategic R&D focuses on developing integrated B2B2C digital warehousing services, smart supply chain platforms, and customized logistics solutions. Expansion plans include scaling multi-modal transport integration, deepening presence in emerging markets like Southeast Asia and China’s import logistics, and advancing supply chain finance capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: T3EX generates revenue mainly through service fees from freight forwarding (sea, air, rail), customs brokerage, warehousing, inland transportation, and supply chain management services. Additional income streams include supply chain finance through factoring and financial services, as well as earnings from strategic and financial investments in related logistics and transportation companies. The company also benefits from long-term contracts and alliances with shipping lines and airlines.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated logistics provider in Asia with a comprehensive service portfolio and extensive regional network. It competes with other major freight forwarders and logistics firms offering multi-modal transport and supply chain solutions. Its competitive advantages include strong IT integration, strategic alliances with global carriers, and a diversified service offering including supply chain finance. Market share in containerized freight and air cargo is modest but growing, with a focus on expanding in China and Southeast Asia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: T3EX reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$28.2 billion in 2022, down 22% year-over-year due to lower freight rates and volumes. Net profit after tax was NT$2.64 billion with earnings per share of NT$18.03. The company has a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$17.7 billion and equity of about NT$9 billion. Despite recent revenue declines, the company pursues growth through acquisitions, regional expansion, and diversification into supply chain finance, aiming for long-term profitability and market share gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: T3EX emphasizes its integrated multi-modal logistics solutions combining sea, air, rail, customs, warehousing, and supply chain finance to provide end-to-end supply chain services. Its proprietary IT systems enable seamless data exchange, real-time cargo tracking, and customized logistics management, enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency. The company’s extensive regional network, strategic partnerships with major carriers, and focus on emerging markets like China’s import logistics and Southeast Asia differentiate it from competitors. Commitment to sustainability and corporate governance further strengthens its market reputation.
